verdict.rationale: Skyvern has a dedicated CAPTCHA docs page stating that its vision model automatically detects and solves reCAPTCHA v2/v3, hCaptcha, Cloudflare Turnstile, FunCaptcha/ArkoseLabs, MTCaptcha and image CAPTCHAs. That is an explicit, documented stance, and the same page describes a terminal-status webhook. Separately documented VNC take-control, human-in-the-loop pauses and failure categories mean a stuck run can be surfaced and handled rather than failing silently, though these are not tied specifically to CAPTCHAs. Missing for 10: documentation of what happens when automatic solving fails (a CAPTCHA-specific human fallback or failure category), independent or hands-on corroboration of solving reliability.
